## ICreateSarifDocumentOptions.tool property

The author of the findings you will add. Defaults to this package at its installed version. A named tool gets only the version you give; this package's version is never attributed to another author.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly tool?: ISarifToolIdentity | undefined;
```
